Overall verdict: needs_changes. The implementer’s declaration and structured target context are correct, and neither recorded command is forbidden. FINDING (high, correctness): Duplicate-identity matching prioritizes an undrifted method/capability pair instead of capability before live order; the failing probe showed locked capabilities `alpha/beta` paired with live `beta/alpha`, falsely reporting capability drift instead of the actual method drift. Recommendation: pair exact identity groups by capability first, independent of method, then fall back to live order. FINDING (medium, test_coverage): The duplicate-identity tests use the same method for both slices and therefore miss this failure; add a regression with matching capabilities but changed/swapped methods. FINDING (low, documentation): The docstring and AC6 test narrow interchangeability to identity+capability+method, contrary to the specified identity+capability rule. FINDING (advisory, documentation): The implementer audit falsely claims `Env: dev` is missing even though it appears in both the prose and structured context. Ruff and `git diff --check` passed; both pytest suites were blocked before collection because the sandbox had no writable temporary directory.
